title: Secure Connectivity to Your Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Cogent is one of the world's largest Internet Service Providers, delivering high-quality Internet, Ethernet and Colocation services.
body_markdown:
*April 8, 2025 by Cogent Marketing*


[In April, we hosted a webinar focused on Cogent's Cloud Connect service. During this webinar, our experts discussed how Cogent’s Cloud Connect service uses Cogent’s high-bandwidth Virtual Private Network or Optical Wavelength connectivity to make your Cloud infrastructure, or the Cloud Infrastructure of your customers, a completely seamless extension of your network.](https://www.cogentco.com/cogent-blog/5059-secure-connectivity-to-your-cloud-infrastructure)
